description:
Tabbing to a highlight callout's button scrolls it into view. The commit also highlights src/zeta.ts line 10 ("Far above the other."). The conversation at /c/{{SLUG}} works in a git repo whose top commit, "Highlighted commit", changes src/zeta.ts (line 160 becomes "const critical = true;"), README.md and src/alpha.ts, and carries commit highlights that rank the files zeta.ts, README.md, alpha.ts and comment on src/zeta.ts line 160 ("The one line that matters.") and README.md line 3 ("Docs follow the code."). "The overlay" is the ".diff-viewer-overlay" element; "the files" are the overlay's ".diff-tree-row[aria-selected]" elements, in document order; "the second file" is the one at index 1 (pick it with "nth": 1, scoped with "within" the overlay). Perform the steps in order.
1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}} and wait for the message input ([data-testid="message-input"]) to be visible (allow 30s).
2. Open the Diffs workspace tool: wait for the ".header" element to be visible, then click the button with accessible name exactly "Diffs" inside ".chat-workspace-actions" (when that toolbar is not shown, click the button named exactly "More options" and then the button whose name starts with "Diffs" in ".chat-overflow-popover"). The overlay becomes visible (allow 30s).
3. Click the second file. It opens at its first highlight; the second is far below: "the notes" are the overlay's elements with role "note"; the first note is in the viewport and the last note is NOT in the viewport.
4. Focus the first note's button with role "button" and name "Comment" (in an eval: .focus()), then press Tab.
5. The last note's button with role "button" and name "Comment" has focus; the last note is in the viewport, and its text contains "The one line that matters.".
6. Press Enter. The ".diff-viewer-comment-dialog" text contains "Add Comment (Line 160, new)".
